name: Serizawa Nono
source:
"Victim #1"

A petite girl with a cute, endearing vibe. She still has a slightly childlike air about her.

She attends a different school than the protagonists and has a gentle, laid-back personality. By chance, she ends up becoming the protagonist’s test subject for his magic experiments.

[From [url=http://mbstruth.com/dmc/cha/cha08.html]official site[/url]]
